players.product: AI data-center campus leases on converted Bitcoin-mining power sites (Sandersville GA 175 MW critical IT on a 20-year triple net lease, tenant undisclosed; Sealy and Brazoria TX under exclusivity)

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's 10-Q: bitcoin mining revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2026 decreased 31% from $198,644 thousand a year earlier, attributed to a lower average bitcoin price and fewer bitcoin mined, as rising global hashrate reduced its relative share of network computational power. It mined 1,920 bitcoin net of mining pool fees in the quarter at an average bitcoin price of $71,881 (2,012 bitcoin at $98,736 a year earlier), and 5,532 bitcoin in the nine months at $82,351 (5,914 at $91,765). Operating miners decreased to 225,137 as of June 30, 2026 from 241,227 as of June 30, 2025, reflecting fleet optimization activities across its operating facilities.
quarterly_data.figure: Quarterly mining revenue -31% YoY; 1,920 bitcoin mined (quarter); 225,137 operating miners (vs 241,227)

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's 10-Q: its one mining pool operator, Foundry Digital, represented 100% of revenue for the nine months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, as all bitcoin mining rewards are received through the Foundry mining pool; Foundry's pool fees equaled approximately 0.26% of gross bitcoin mining revenues in the quarter and 0.22% in the nine months.
quarterly_data.figure: Foundry Digital 100% of revenue (nine months to June 30, 2026); pool fees ~0.26% (quarter)

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's 10-Q: at owned facilities the cost of energy per bitcoin mined was $44,317 in the quarter ended June 30, 2026 ($44,690 a year earlier), at $0.053 per kWh over 1,602,779,051 kWh; the direct cost to mine one bitcoin including miner depreciation was $96,277 against average revenue of $71,692 per bitcoin mined (134.3% of average bitcoin mining revenue, versus 87.5% a year earlier). Payments on miners and mining equipment, including deposits, were $32,374 thousand in the nine months versus $382,285 thousand a year earlier; its contractual obligations primarily consist of cancelable purchase commitments, primarily for mining equipment and construction costs.
quarterly_data.figure: Cost to mine $96,277 vs revenue $71,692 per bitcoin (quarter); miner payments $32,374 thousand (nine months) vs $382,285 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's 10-Q cash flow statement: in the nine months ended June 30, 2026 it spent $35,277 thousand on asset acquisitions of Austin County, TX locations, $38,214 thousand on Brazoria County, TX locations and $13,293 thousand on other locations.
quarterly_data.figure: Austin County, TX $35,277 thousand; Brazoria County, TX $38,214 thousand (nine months to June 30, 2026)
